rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware form factors and spatial computing from his work on Vision Pro and hand-tracking at Leap Motion, while Sid is building computer-vision-powered products at scale within Verkada's cloud platform. Their combination of bleeding-edge hardware design and proven product-market fit in vision-based systems could unlock new possibilities for integrating generative AI with physical security and IoT devices.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Sid Dedhia — you're both in San Francisco working at the intersection of computer vision and next-generation hardware/software integration, and could explore how AI-native form factors might reshape physical security and monitoring.
